header.title: Muse UFO-S services
header.description: Executable commitment-based service offering, negotiation, agreement, delivery, outcome and lifecycle package, including corrigendum corrections.

definition.text: A claim held by one party against another concerning the content identified by this the UFO-S service ontology category.
A commitment whose bearer is bound by the customer content or role specified in the UFO-S service ontology.
An event part representing the participation of a customer participant in an event.
An anti-rigid sortal whose instances satisfy a contingent relational condition in the UFO-S service ontology.
An anti-rigid classification whose instances satisfy a contingent intrinsic condition during the delivery stage.
A service result representing a state of affairs in which failure conditions obtain.
An anti-rigid classification whose instances satisfy a contingent intrinsic condition during the negotiation stage.
An anti-rigid classification whose instances satisfy a contingent intrinsic condition during the offering stage.
An anti-rigid classification whose instances satisfy a contingent intrinsic condition during the post-delivery stage.
A claim held by one party against another concerning the content identified by this the UFO-S service ontology category.
A commitment whose bearer is bound by the provider content or role specified in the UFO-S service ontology.
An event part representing the participation of a provider participant in an event.
An anti-rigid sortal whose instances satisfy a contingent relational condition in the UFO-S service ontology.
A service result representing a state of affairs in which satisfaction conditions obtain.
A service thing recognized as capable of bearing or exercising the agency associated with service agent in the UFO-S service ontology.
A service thing that mediates the parties and correlated dependent moments constituting a service agreement.
A disposition whose bearer can realize the behavior or institutional effect identified by service capability in the UFO-S service ontology.
A specialization of target customer used to represent service customer in the UFO-S service ontology.
A specialization of service thing, action used to represent service delivery in the UFO-S service ontology.
A normative or descriptive social object that specifies the content and conditions of service description in the UFO-S service ontology.
A service agreement that mediates the parties and correlated dependent moments constituting a service-level agreement.
A specialization of service thing, complex event used to represent service lifecycle in the UFO-S service ontology.
A specialization of service thing, interaction used to represent service negotiation in the UFO-S service ontology.
A specialization of service thing, social relator used to represent service offering in the UFO-S service ontology.
A claim held by one party against another concerning the content identified by this the UFO-S service ontology category.
A commitment whose bearer is bound by the service offering content or role specified in the UFO-S service ontology.
An event part representing the participation of a service participant in an event.
A specialization of service agent used to represent service provider in the UFO-S service ontology.
A specialization of service thing, resource used to represent service resource in the UFO-S service ontology.
A situation brought about by the relevant process and evaluated as a service result in the UFO-S service ontology.
An anti-rigid sortal whose instances satisfy a contingent relational condition in the UFO-S service ontology.
A normative or descriptive social object that specifies the content and conditions of service specification in the UFO-S service ontology.
A specialization of entity used to represent service thing in the UFO-S service ontology.
A specialization of service agent used to represent target customer in the UFO-S service ontology.
An anti-rigid non-sortal whose instances play a common relational role in the UFO-S service ontology.
